Subject: Personal Loan Application – Shawn Franklin

Dear Loan Officer,

My name is Shawn Franklin, and I would like to apply for a personal loan. I am currently a part-time electrical consultant working 20 hours per week, and I receive $2,800 per month in retirement and Social Security benefits. In addition, due to alimony payments, my net monthly income has increased by $1,250, bringing my total reliable monthly income to approximately $4,050.

The purpose of this loan is to help cover significant recent and ongoing expenses, including $1,200 in medical expenses over the past year, $4,200 in legal fees related to my ongoing divorce case (filed August 1, 2024), $5,800 paid toward my rehabilitation program, and recurring costs of $95 per month for medication and $150 per month for therapy sessions. I am requesting a loan in the range of $12,000 to consolidate these expenses and manage them through a single, structured repayment plan.

By way of background on my financial position: I own a single-family home at 8382 Adam Fort, Lake Kimberlyburgh, West Virginia 48656, where I currently pay $900 per month toward the shared mortgage. As part of the divorce settlement, the home equity will be divided equally between the parties, and I plan to move to a downsized condo in January 2025, which will further reduce my housing costs. I also receive $500 per month in rent assistance from a victim assistance program, which provides additional monthly support.

While my consulting work is part-time, my retirement and Social Security benefits and alimony provide a stable income base, and my planned housing transition will lower my monthly obligations. I am confident in my ability to meet the repayment terms and would welcome the opportunity to discuss loan options, interest rates, and repayment schedules that fit my circumstances.

Please let me know what documentation you need from me to move forward with the application. I can be reached at your convenience, and I look forward to working with you.

Sincerely,
Shawn Franklin
8382 Adam Fort, Lake Kimberlyburgh, West Virginia 48656
